weapon_help.description: Shows the specified page in the weapon menu.

weapon_list.description: Shows a list of registered weapons.

weapon_give.description: Gives the specified weapon to a player, if registered. Usable from console. Amount is capped at 2304 (36 stacks).

weapon_get.description: Gives yourself the specified weapon, if registered. Amount is capped at 2304 (36 stacks).

weapon_info.description: Shows the information of the held weapon or of the specified name.

ammunition_help.description: Shows the specified page in the ammo menu.

ammunition_give.description: Gives the player the specified ammo if registered.

ammunition_info.description: Shows the information of the held ammo or of the specified name.

wearable_help.description: Shows the specified page in the wearable menu.

wearable_info.description: Shows information about the specified wearable item.

bartizan_debug.description: Lists the UUID of every currently loaded weapon.
